title: Python workflow inventory contract references a removed verified-report governance job
protocol: GitHub Actions Python workflow inventory contract
observed_behavior: On Parent master dd175053b3d7f509286af87646d6eb093a49d578, rtk proxy make check-python-version-contract exits 2 because the exact inventory still requires verified-report-governance.yml:verified-report-contract-preflight while .github/workflows/verified-report-governance.yml no longer defines that job. The workflow, checker, and Makefile scope is identical to origin/master and is not changed by PR #138.
expected_behavior: The explicit Python-job inventory and the checked-in workflows describe the same current contract, so rtk proxy make check-python-version-contract exits 0 on current Parent master while continuing to fail closed for a genuinely missing required Python job.
impact: A mandatory Parent Python workflow contract fails on current master. It blocks trustworthy CI validation and can mask meaningful inventory drift behind a permanently failing baseline. This is a P1 CI release blocker, not a security finding.
preconditions: Parent master dd175053b3d7f509286af87646d6eb093a49d578 is the compared revision.
reproduction: Confirm git diff --quiet origin/master -- .github/workflows/verified-report-governance.yml ci/checks/common/check-python-version-contract.py Makefile exits 0 for the candidate under review.
Observe exit 2 and the unaltered error: python-version-contract: expected normal Python job is absent: verified-report-governance.yml:verified-report-contract-preflight.

evidence.command: git diff --quiet origin/master -- .github/workflows/verified-report-governance.yml ci/checks/common/check-python-version-contract.py Makefile; rtk proxy make check-python-version-contract
evidence.result: The scope-equivalence control exited 0. The checked-in validator requires verified-report-governance.yml:verified-report-contract-preflight, the current workflow omits that job, and make check-python-version-contract exited 2. No workflow, scanner, suppression, Framework, MRTS, Gitlink, or delivery state changed while collecting the receipt.

root_cause: ci/checks/common/check-python-version-contract.py inventories verified-report-governance.yml:verified-report-contract-preflight, but .github/workflows/verified-report-governance.yml no longer defines it.
proposed_remediation: Create a separate focused Parent workflow/checker-alignment PR that preserves the canonical Python setup and workflow trust controls, adds a regression test, and obtains hosted proof. The repair must restore a truthful exact inventory/workflow relationship without silently folding the work into PR #138.
acceptance_criteria: The explicit inventory and the defined verified-report-governance jobs are aligned at the exact corrective PR head without weakening canonical Python setup or workflow trust controls.
rtk proxy make check-python-version-contract exits 0 on the aligned source tree.
A focused regression demonstrates that the selected contract relationship is preserved and that an actually missing required Python job still fails closed.
The existing Python workflow inventory remains explicit; no broad filename or job-name pattern replaces the exact identities.
Focused local checks and exact-head hosted workflow proof pass before the finding moves beyond validated.
The remediation is delivered through a separate focused Parent PR, not silently folded into PR #138.
validation_plan: Add or update focused coverage in tests/test_python_version_contract.py for the selected inventory/workflow alignment and an independent missing-job negative control.
Run rtk proxy make check-python-version-contract and the focused Python contract tests without changing the canonical Python-version or trust-control policy.
Run workflow syntax and applicable CI-contract checks, then review the exact corrective PR head.
Obtain hosted proof for the exact corrective head and rerun the original make target on the resulting Parent master before verified or closed status.
legitimate_control_tests: The aligned current workflow inventory passes with the canonical .python-version setup path and verifier contract intact.
A deliberately absent different required Python job remains rejected by inventory_violations.
The verified-report-governance workflow retains its existing least-privilege and trust-control topology.
dependencies: Exact-head hosted workflow proof and resulting-master rerun
residual_risk: Until a separate focused Parent alignment repair passes its exact-head hosted proof and the original make target is rerun on resulting master, the mandatory Python workflow inventory contract remains unusable as a passing current-master control. No workflow trust-control weakening, scanner change, suppression, Framework/MRTS action, Gitlink update, or risk acceptance is recorded.
residual_risk_de: Bis eine getrennte fokussierte Parent-Alignment-Reparatur ihren Exact-Head-Hosted-Nachweis besteht und das ursprüngliche Make-Target auf dem resultierenden Master erneut läuft, bleibt der verpflichtende Python-Workflow-Inventarvertrag als bestehender Master-Control nicht nutzbar. Es sind keine Abschwächung eines Workflow-Trust-Controls, Scanner-Änderung, Suppression, Framework-/MRTS-Aktion, Gitlink-Update oder Risikoakzeptanz erfasst.

history.detail: The retained receipt hash 17ae8b2b76e65e4f9db7625122b56f5d74c171bed69912f6ba2a68198b3b283e proves the current-master-equivalent scope and the independent exit-2 reproduction. The finding is separately tracked from PR #138 because its workflow/checker alignment root cause and focused remediation boundary are independent.
